text: Which latency component is the ONLY one that grows with offered load?
explanation: Propagation depends on distance and medium; transmission on packet size and link rate; processing on the device's work per packet. Only queueing depends on other people's traffic, and it grows non-linearly — as rho/(1-rho) — which is why raising utilisation from 50% to 90% multiplies queueing delay ninefold.
